Natural Earth — admin-0 countries and admin-1 states/provinces
===============================================================

Source:   Natural Earth, version 5.1.1 (https://www.naturalearthdata.com)
          ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces  -> admin1.topo.json  (object "regions")
          ne_50m_admin_0_countries         -> admin0.topo.json  (object "countries")
Licence:  Public domain. "All versions of Natural Earth raster + vector map data
          found on this website are in the public domain. You may use the maps in
          any manner, including modifying the content and design, electronic
          dissemination, and offset printing." — naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use
          No permission or attribution is required; credit is given here anyway:
          "Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com."

Boundaries are Natural Earth's de facto view and are used only to light the
regions a car has driven in on the 足迹 / Footprint page. Country names shown to
the user come from the car's own reverse-geocoded addresses, not from this file.

How these files were made (mapshaper 0.6.102):
  mapshaper ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces.shp \
    -filter-fields name,name_en,name_zh,name_alt,gn_name,woe_name,iso_a2,adm0_a3 \
    -simplify 4% weighted keep-shapes -rename-layers regions \
    -o format=topojson quantization=50000
  mapshaper ne_50m_admin_0_countries.shp \
    -filter-fields NAME,NAME_EN,NAME_ZH,ISO_A2,ISO_A2_EH,ADM0_A3 \
    -simplify 12% weighted keep-shapes -rename-layers countries \
    -o format=topojson quantization=50000
then the properties were reduced to: c (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), e (English name),
z (Chinese name) and, for regions, k (other names, "|"-joined, for matching).
